notes.title: Update 28.02
notes.content:
In this update, we continue to focus on addressing the aspects that were considered least predominant by the majority.

[b]List of major changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Graphics.[/b] The game has undergone many visible graphical improvements. The visual elements are now even more realistic.
[*] [b]Narrative.[/b] The format and sequence of the storyline have been changed for greater clarity.
[*] [b]Settings.[/b] Now, settings that were previously only available for changes in the menu can be adjusted at any point during the gameplay.
[*] [b]Miscellaneous.[/b] The game has undergone various changes that positively impact overall optimization and player immersion.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 10.01
notes.content:
[b]The first correctional update[/b] for [b]"Cursed New Year"[/b], which focuses on correcting the main points that previously hindered a comfortable gameplay, as well as adding elements for greater immersion.

[b]- Graphics.[/b] The overall game graphics have been partially changed for the better, and the location has gained more illumination due to redesigned lighting.

[b]- Optimization. [/b] The results of in-game tests of the updated version confirm a more efficient use of device resources compared to the previous version. This results in improved performance and smoother gameplay.

[b]- Other.[/b] According to statistics and feedback from players, the previous version of the game had problems with the achievement system. Achievements have been adjusted in the latest update.
